en.headline: Man arrested after trying to open bank account with fake $1,000 notes in Central
en.dek: Police said a man in his 70s from the mainland was held after bank staff in IFC Tower 2 spotted seven suspected counterfeit notes around midday on Wednesday.
body: Police arrested a man on suspicion of uttering counterfeit banknotes after he tried to open an account at a bank in Two International Finance Centre in Central on Wednesday.

According to reports, bank staff alerted police around 12:50 p.m. after the man, believed to be in his 70s and from the mainland, presented seven $1,000 notes that felt unusual. Officers attended, examined the notes and arrested him. He was taken to a police station for further investigation.

The case is being followed up by the Central Police District. Authorities have not released the man’s name. Members of the public are reminded to check banknotes carefully and report anything suspicious to the police or the bank.

zh.headline: 中環國金男子持7張偽千元鈔開戶被捕
zh.dek: 警方指一名約70歲內地男子周三中午在國際金融中心二期銀行被揭發，職員發現鈔票質感有異後報警。
body: 警方周三拘捕一名男子，涉嫌在中環國際金融中心二期一間銀行以偽鈔開戶。
據報道，銀行職員約中午12時50分報案，指該名約70歲內地男子出示7張1000元紙幣，質感異常。警員到場檢查後將他拘捕，帶返警署調查。
案件由中區警區跟進。警方暫未公布被捕人姓名。市民應小心檢查鈔票，如有懷疑可向警方或銀行舉報。
